courseTitle: Ancient Egypt — The Nile, Pyramids & Pharaohs (c. 3100–30 BC)
disclaimer: The History Revision Hub — Key Stage 2 Primary History Mind Map.

root.label: Ancient Egypt
root.gloss: Three thousand years beside the River Nile — from black flood silt, Giza’s pyramids, and hieroglyphs to mummies, New Kingdom pharaohs, Tutankhamun, and Cleopatra VII.

children.label: 1. Gift of the Nile & Giza
children.gloss: Annual Nile floods fed fertile Black Land farms united by King Narmer before paid skilled builders raised Giza’s Great Pyramid and Great Sphinx.

children.label: 1. River Cradles & The Nile
children.q2Chain: Four river cradles & black Kemet flood mud → Shaduf ditches & Nile sail boats → King Narmer unites Egypt (c. 3100 BC)
children.gloss: Four river cradles & black Kemet flood mud → Shaduf ditches & Nile sail boats → King Narmer unites Egypt (c. 3100 BC)

children.label: Four Cradles & Black Kemet Mud
children.gloss: Like Sumer, the Indus Valley, and Shang China, Egypt grew beside a river whose summer flood left rich black Kemet silt.

children.label: Four Early River Civilisations
children.gloss: Sumer, Indus, and Shang China; Desert sand surrounded River Nile.

children.label: Summer Flood Left Black Kemet
children.gloss: Yearly inundation soaked river banks; Black Kemet edged red Deshret.

children.label: → Rich Silt Invited Canal Farms
children.gloss: Stopped desert sand starving Egypt; Gave damp soil every summer.

children.label: Shadufs, Papyrus & Nile Boats
children.gloss: Farmers swung wooden shaduf levers to water wheat, barley, and flax while wooden boats drifted north and sailed south.

children.label: Shaduf Levers Lifted Cool Water
children.gloss: Dug neat mud irrigation ditches; Mud weight watered higher gardens.

children.label: Wheat, Flax, Papyrus & Boats
children.gloss: Grew bread wheat and flax; Drifted north, sailed back south.

children.label: → Linked Valley & Delta Towns
children.gloss: Cut tall marsh papyrus reeds; Carried grain along busy Nile.

children.label: Narmer Unites Two Lands
children.gloss: Around 3100 BC, southern warrior King Narmer united hilly Upper Egypt and marshy Lower Egypt under one Double Crown.

children.label: Rival Kings Split Two Lands
children.gloss: Nile flowed north downhill seaward; Southern Upper vs marshy Lower.

children.label: Narmer Joined Red & White Crowns
children.gloss: Marched north around 3100 BC; Carved famous stone Narmer Palette.

children.label: → One Kingdom Ready for Pyramids
children.gloss: Rulers wore united Double Crown; Funded Old Kingdom royal builders.

children.label: 2. Giza Pyramids & The Sphinx
children.q2Chain: Imhotep’s Step Pyramid & Khufu’s Great Pyramid → Barges & wet-sand sledges → Paid builders’ village & Khafre’s Great Sphinx
children.gloss: Imhotep’s Step Pyramid & Khufu’s Great Pyramid → Barges & wet-sand sledges → Paid builders’ village & Khafre’s Great Sphinx

children.label: Imhotep & Khufu’s Great Pyramid
children.gloss: Honouring Pharaohs as living gods, Imhotep stacked Djoser’s Step Pyramid before Khufu raised Giza’s 146-metre Great Pyramid.

children.label: Pharaohs Honoured as Living Gods
children.gloss: Kept order and good floods; Replaced low mud-brick royal tombs.

children.label: Step Pyramid to 146m Giza Giant
children.gloss: Imhotep stacked six Saqqara steps; Khufu stacked 2.3 million blocks.

children.label: → Needed Clever Stone Transport
children.gloss: Tallest building for 4,000 years; Built without cranes or wheels.

children.label: Chisels, Barges & Wet Sand
children.gloss: Masons split quarry rock with copper chisels, floated white Tura limestone on flood barges, and pulled sledges over wet sand.

children.label: Copper Chisels & Flood Barges
children.gloss: Soaked wood wedges split stone; Floated white Tura limestone blocks.

children.label: Water Poured Ahead of Sledges
children.gloss: Tied two-tonne blocks on sledges; Wet sand halved rubbing friction.

children.label: → Hauled Blocks Up Sloping Ramps
children.gloss: Crews pulled smoothly from harbour; Left builders’ clues beside Giza.

children.label: Paid Builders & The Great Sphinx
children.gloss: Excavated bakeries, fish rations, and healed bones proved paid skilled workers — not slaves — built Giza and Khafre’s Great Sphinx.

children.label: Bakeries, Fish & Set Bones
children.gloss: Walled villages fed beef, fish; Doctors set broken worker bones.

children.label: Khafre Carved the Great Sphinx
children.gloss: Lion body with royal head; Carved straight from limestone ridge.

children.label: Busted the Unpaid Slave Myth
children.gloss: Paid farmers worked proud teams; Proved organised Egyptian society worked.

children.label: 2. Daily Life, Scribes & Gods
children.gloss: Egypt’s social pyramid linked peasant farmers and mud-brick homes to elite hieroglyph scribes, 70-day mummification, and Weighing the Heart.

children.label: 3. Scribes & Everyday Life
children.q2Chain: Pharaohs to farmers on social pyramid → Cool mud-brick homes, linen & Senet → Champollion cracks Rosetta Stone (1822)
children.gloss: Pharaohs to farmers on social pyramid → Cool mud-brick homes, linen & Senet → Champollion cracks Rosetta Stone (1822)

children.label: Egypt’s Layered Social Pyramid
children.gloss: Below the god-king Pharaoh stood viziers, priests, and scribes, while craftworkers and millions of peasant farmers formed the base.

children.label: Pharaoh, Viziers, Priests & Scribes
children.gloss: Viziers and priests advised Pharaoh; Scribes counted grain and taxes.

children.label: Craftworkers & Peasant Farmers
children.gloss: Made blue glaze hippo William; Farmers’ grain taxes fed Egypt.

children.label: → Shared Clever Nile Home Life
children.gloss: Potters, weavers, jewellers filled towns; Adapted daily life to heat.

children.label: Mud-Brick Homes, Linen & Senet
children.gloss: Families stayed cool inside whitewashed mud-brick houses with flat roofs, wore white flax linen, and raced counters on Senet boards.

children.label: Blazing Desert Sun Needed Shade
children.gloss: Whitewashed walls bounced away heat; Families slept on flat roofs.

children.label: White Linen, Figs & Senet Games
children.gloss: Wore airy linen, reed sandals; Baked flatbread with figs, lentils.

children.label: → Scribes Recorded Daily Voices
children.gloss: Raced counters across thirty squares; Papyrus scrolls preserved Egyptian life.

children.label: 700+ Hieroglyphs & Rosetta Stone
children.gloss: Scribes brushed over 700 hieroglyphs onto papyrus; in 1822 Jean-François Champollion cracked the code using the Rosetta Stone.

children.label: Strict Scribe School & Papyrus
children.gloss: Practised 700+ signs with reeds; Script forgotten for long centuries.

children.label: Champollion Cracked Code in 1822
children.gloss: 1799 soldiers dug Rosetta Stone; Matched Greek names to cartouches.

children.label: Unlocked 3,000 Years of Writing
children.gloss: Carved in 196 BC scripts; Let historians read tomb prayers.

children.label: 4. Gods, Mummies & Afterlife
children.q2Chain: Polytheistic gods & twin spirits (ka and ba) → 70-day natron mummification & Canopic jars → Weighing the Heart before Osiris
children.gloss: Polytheistic gods & twin spirits (ka and ba) → 70-day natron mummification & Canopic jars → Weighing the Heart before Osiris

children.label: Gods & Twin Spirits (Ka & Ba)
children.gloss: Egyptians worshipped Ra, Osiris, Isis, Horus, Anubis, and Thoth, believing twin ka and ba spirits needed a preserved body.

children.label: Ra, Osiris, Isis, Horus & Anubis
children.gloss: Sun god Ra sailed sky; Jackal-headed Anubis guarded sandy tombs.

children.label: Ka & Ba Needed Lasting Body
children.gloss: Ibis-headed Thoth wrote sacred wisdom; Rotted bodies left spirits homeless.

children.label: → Priests Invented 70-Day Mummies
children.gloss: Falcon Horus guarded living pharaohs; Drove careful tomb preservation rituals.

children.label: 70 Days: Natron & Canopic Jars
children.gloss: Over seventy days, priests stored four organs in Canopic jars, left the heart inside, dried skin in natron salt, and wrapped linen.

children.label: Four Canopic Jars & Natron Salt
children.gloss: Kept heart inside for memories; Dried forty days in natron.

children.label: Linen Wraps, Scarab & Shabtis
children.gloss: Tucked heart scarab over chest; Blue shabtis farmed in afterlife.

children.label: → Ready for Hall of Two Truths
children.gloss: Rubbed sweet oils on skin; Prepared spirit for final judgement.

children.label: Weighing the Heart Before Osiris
children.gloss: Guided by Book of the Dead scrolls, Anubis weighed each heart against Ma’at’s feather of truth beside hungry monster Ammit.

children.label: Heart Balanced Against Ma’at Feather
children.gloss: Book of the Dead guided; Thoth wrote down scale result.

children.label: Monster Ammit vs Field of Reeds
children.gloss: Ammit gobbled heavy mean hearts; Kind hearts entered sunny Reeds.

children.label: Taught Kind & Honest Living
children.gloss: Osiris welcomed light honest hearts; Shaped morals across all Egypt.

children.label: 3. Great Rulers & KV62 Tomb
children.gloss: New Kingdom rulers Hatshepsut, Nefertiti, and Ramesses II shaped Egypt’s golden age before Cleopatra VII fell to Rome and Howard Carter opened Tutankhamun’s tomb.

children.label: 5. Hatshepsut to Ramesses II
children.q2Chain: Hatshepsut’s Punt trade expedition → Akhenaten & Nefertiti worship Aten at Amarna → Ramesses II’s Kadesh peace treaty & Abu Simbel
children.gloss: Hatshepsut’s Punt trade expedition → Akhenaten & Nefertiti worship Aten at Amarna → Ramesses II’s Kadesh peace treaty & Abu Simbel

children.label: Pharaoh Hatshepsut & Punt Ships
children.gloss: Crowning herself full pharaoh with the royal false beard, Hatshepsut sailed five ships to Punt for gold and living incense trees.

children.label: Female Pharaoh Wore False Beard
children.gloss: Ruled New Kingdom from Thebes; Wore striped royal kingly headcloth.

children.label: Five Ships Sailed to Punt
children.gloss: Brought gold, ebony, frankincense trees; Carved cliff Deir el-Bahari temple.

children.label: → Peaceful Trade Enriched Karnak
children.gloss: Chose Red Sea trade first; Funded grand New Kingdom temples.

children.label: Akhenaten & Nefertiti at Amarna
children.gloss: Akhenaten and powerful Queen Nefertiti shocked priests by building desert Amarna to worship one golden sun-disc called Aten.

children.label: Worshipped One Sun-Disc Aten
children.gloss: Turned away from old gods; Built brand-new capital at Amarna.

children.label: Nefertiti’s Chariots & Blue Bust
children.gloss: Led offerings beside her husband; Thutmose carved painted limestone bust.

children.label: → Priests Restored Old Gods Fast
children.gloss: Shocked traditional priests at Karnak; Old worship returned after death.

children.label: Ramesses II, Kadesh & Abu Simbel
children.gloss: Ruling 66 years, Ramesses II fought Hittite chariots at Kadesh, signed the oldest written peace treaty, and carved Abu Simbel.

children.label: Chariot Clash at Kadesh (1274 BC)
children.gloss: Fought Hittites; neither side won; Ruled Egypt sixty-six long years.

children.label: 1259 BC Peace & 20m Colossi
children.gloss: Oldest surviving written peace treaty; Carved four 20m Abu Simbel statues.

children.label: Won Decades of Border Peace
children.gloss: Sunbeams lit cliff temple twice; Earned title Ramesses the Great.

children.label: 6. Tutankhamun & Cleopatra VII
children.q2Chain: Tutankhamun hidden under rubble in KV62 (1323 BC) → Carter & Egyptian team open KV62 (1922) → Cleopatra VII & Roman conquest (30 BC)
children.gloss: Tutankhamun hidden under rubble in KV62 (1323 BC) → Carter & Egyptian team open KV62 (1922) → Cleopatra VII & Roman conquest (30 BC)

children.label: Boy-King Hidden Inside KV62
children.gloss: Crowned aged nine, Tutankhamun died aged nineteen in 1323 BC; limestone rubble hid his small Valley of the Kings tomb from robbers.

children.label: Pyramids Tempted Greedy Robbers
children.gloss: Cut secret desert cliff tombs; Crowned boy-pharaoh aged just nine.

children.label: Rubble Hid KV62’s Buried Steps
children.gloss: Died suddenly aged nineteen years; Later builders dumped limestone rubble.

children.label: → Escaped Thieves Until AD 1922
children.gloss: Huge nearby tombs were robbed; Golden treasures slept 3,200 years.

children.label: 1922: Opening KV62’s Treasures
children.gloss: In November 1922, water-boy Hussein Abdel Rassoul found the top step, leading Howard Carter and Egyptian excavators to 5,000 treasures.

children.label: Hussein Spotted First Stone Step
children.gloss: Cleared sixteen buried stone steps; Carter gasped at wonderful things.

children.label: 5,000 Finds & 11kg Gold Mask
children.gloss: Gilded chariots, thrones, Senet boards; Solid 11kg gold death mask.

children.label: Richest Intact Royal Tomb Found
children.gloss: Took ten years to catalogue; Shared Egyptian craftwork worldwide.

children.label: Alexandria & Queen Cleopatra VII
children.gloss: After Alexander founded Alexandria in 332 BC, nine-language Ptolemaic Queen Cleopatra VII ruled wisely until Roman armies won in 30 BC.

children.label: Alexander Founded Port Alexandria
children.gloss: Built tall lighthouse and library; Began Greek-speaking Ptolemaic dynasty.

children.label: Nine-Language Cleopatra vs Rome
children.gloss: Learned Egyptian plus eight languages; Roman fleet defeated her 30 BC.

children.label: → Ended 3,000 Years of Pharaohs
children.gloss: Turned Egypt into Roman province; Ancient wonders still amaze today.
